hook.say: How well do you know Europe? Five questions, three seconds each. The last one stumps most people!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: In which country is the Colosseum?
questions.fact: Opened in AD 80, it is the largest ancient amphitheater ever built.
questions.sayAnswer: Italy! The Colosseum in Rome opened in the year 80, and it is the largest ancient amphitheater ever built.

questions.q: Which is the longest river in Europe?
questions.fact: The Volga runs about 3,500 km across Russia to the Caspian Sea.
questions.sayAnswer: The Volga! It runs about 3,500 kilometers across Russia, to the Caspian Sea.

questions.q: Which European Union country has the most people?
questions.fact: Germany has about 84 million people. France is next, with about 68 million.
questions.sayAnswer: Germany! It has about 84 million people. France is next, with about 68 million.

questions.q: Which river flows through four national capitals?
questions.fact: Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and Belgrade all sit on the Danube.
questions.sayAnswer: The Danube! Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and Belgrade all sit on its banks.

questions.q: Which European country is doubly landlocked?
questions.fact: Its only neighbors, Switzerland and Austria, are landlocked too.
questions.sayAnswer: Lick-ten-stine! Its only neighbors, Switzerland and Austria, are landlocked too. Only Uzbekistan shares that fate.
